description: Multi-step eval tasks for the filesystem-skill-discovery feature. Each task is one realistic workflow: discover a tool by intent, fetch that skill's tool rows, filter them in memory, compose a bounded projection, and emit it. The three evaluation arms (shelf reads, sequential gateway calls, one code-exec plan) run every task on these identical inputs. This is a NEW eval set and is independent of the committed golden/fresh/paraphrase routing sets and their gate floors.

pipeline.fetch: all tool rows belonging to the discovered skill (id + summary)
pipeline.filter: keep rows whose summary matches 'grep' as a case-insensitive regex
pipeline.compose: de-duplicate matched ids, sort lexically, take the first 3

expected_result_note: Expected results are a snapshot of the omnicli catalog at authoring time. They are ground truth for correctness comparison, not computed at run time. Regenerate them deliberately if the catalog changes.

tasks.intent: canvas-cli list courses modules assignments grades
jev-decision typed bool choice score primitive
